reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes Mn-free CrCoNi has lower stacking fault energy (SFE) than CrMnFeCoNi, whereas experiments consistently show the opposite; the proposed magnetic mechanism for SFE reduction is speculative and contradicts known trends.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis by measuring hcp phase fraction and magnetic ordering, though the predicted outcome is physically unlikely.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a physically incorrect premise about SFE trends, which would misdirect research efforts.
